name: What are the benefits of repairing a broken window versus DIY methods?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of repairing a broken window versus DIY methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional repair ensures safety, proper installation, and long-term durability. Our technicians have the specialized tools, experience, and knowledge to handle various glass types and window frames correctly, minimizing risks of injury or further damage. DIY repairs often lead to incorrect sealing, potential safety hazards, or a need for re-repair, costing more in the long run. Professionals also guarantee compliance with local building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional repair offers safety, proper installation, durability, and compliance with building codes, which DIY methods often lack.
